name: campus-twin-agent
description: Human + Agent workplace twin for Sopra Steria Noida: 3D/2D wayfinding studio, built-in concierge agent, WebMCP and MCP tool servers.

scripts.mcp: npm run build:mcp && npm run start --workspace=@campus-twin/mcp-server
scripts.api: npm run build:api && npm run start --workspace=@campus-twin/api
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=@campus-twin/mcp-server
scripts.build:api: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=@campus-twin/api
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=@campus-twin/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace=@campus-twin/api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@campus-twin/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@campus-twin/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@campus-twin/api
